description: Defines classes, structs, and interfaces for tone mapping in Android graphics, including shader uniform descriptions, metadata, color conversions, and a ToneMapper interface for generating shader code and CPU gain calculations.

classes.name: ShaderUniform
classes.description: Represents a shader uniform with a name and value, used for passing data into shaders.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Contains metadata for shader construction, including luminance levels, hardware buffer reference, and render intent.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Utility class for color conversions, holding linear RGB and XYZ representations.

classes.name: ToneMapper
classes.description: Interface for generating tonemap shaders, uniforms, and CPU gain calculations.

methods.name: generateTonemapGainShaderSkSL
methods.description: Generates a SkSL shader string for tonemapping between specified dataspaces.

methods.name: generateShaderSkSLUniforms
methods.description: Creates shader uniform descriptions based on provided metadata.

methods.name: lookupTonemapGain
methods.description: Computes tonemapping gain values on CPU for given colors and metadata.
